subject: Embryology
question: A newborn baby is noted to have a left unilateral cleft lip. There are no abnormalities of the baby's palate. Which of the following developmental defects accounts for this occurrence?

options.A: Failure of the left lateral palatine process to fuse with the median palatine process
options.B: Failure of the left maxillary prominence to unite with the left medial nasal prominence
options.C: Failure of the right and left medial nasal prominences to merge
options.D: Failure of the left maxillary process to fuse with the left medial nasal process

explanation: Explanation:: Mid line cleft lip is failure of fusion of two medial nasal processes. Unilateral cleft lip failure of fusion of median nasal process with maxillary process. Cleft palate failure of fusion of lateral palatine process nasal septum and median palatine process
